author: Dragon-ThreatResearchHQ
description: Detects OpenSSH daemon (sshd) spawning interactive shells or command interpreters without a corresponding authenticated PAM session, indicating exploitation of the RegreSSHion signal race condition (CVE-2024-6387).
falsepositives: Normal interactive SSH logins if auditd/sysmon does not distinguish privilege separation child processes.
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE ParentImage LIKE '%/sshd' ESCAPE '\' AND (Image LIKE '%/sh' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/bash' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/dash' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/zsh' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/python' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/python3' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/perl' ESCAPE '\')
title: Pre-Auth sshd Spawning Shell (RegreSSHion CVE-2024-6387)

author: Dragon Threat Research HQ
description: Detects command-line execution or script invocation writing zero or random data directly to raw disk block devices (/dev/sd*, /dev/nvme*, /dev/mtd*) characteristic of destructive Linux wipers deployed by Russian state-sponsored actor Sandworm (APT44) such as AcidRain and AcidPour.
falsepositives: Authorized storage decommissioning or disk re-imaging by datacenter technicians
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE (Image LIKE '%/dd' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/shred' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/wipe' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%of=/dev/sd%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%of=/dev/nvme%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%of=/dev/mtd%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%of=/dev/mmcblk%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/dev/urandom%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/dev/zero%' ESCAPE '\')
title: Suspicious Direct Block Device Overwrite or MTD Flash Destruction (Sandworm Wiper TTP)

author: Dragon Threat Intelligence
description: Detects Python process executing encoded or uncompressed commands inside Ivanti SQL/web directories, characteristic of WIREFIRE web shells.
falsepositives: None on standard Ivanti Connect Secure appliances
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE (CommandLine LIKE '%/home/etc/sql/d\_admin.py%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%/home/webserver/htdocs/dana-na/%' ESCAPE '\') OR (CommandLine LIKE '%zlib.decompress%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%base64.b64decode%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%exec(%' ESCAPE '\')
title: WIREFIRE Web Shell Execution on Linux Appliance (UNC5221)

author: Dragon Threat Intelligence
description: Detects command injection artifacts executed by device telemetry cron tasks on PAN-OS Linux systems.
falsepositives: None known on standard PAN-OS systems
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE CommandLine LIKE '%/opt/panlogs/tmp/device\_telemetry/minute/%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%curl${IFS}%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%running-config.xml%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%system.pth%' ESCAPE '\'
title: PAN-OS Device Telemetry Arbitrary Command Execution (CVE-2024-3400)

author: Dragon Threat Research HQ
description: Detects sshd directly spawning an unauthenticated interactive shell or command execution utility without a standard PAM session, characteristic of the XZ Utils upstream IFUNC backdoor (CVE-2024-3094) triggering arbitrary root execution.
falsepositives: Custom restricted SSH command triggers (e.g., git-shell, rsync over ssh)
rule: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE ParentImage LIKE '%/sshd' ESCAPE '\' AND (Image LIKE '%/sh' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/bash' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/dash' ESCAPE '\' OR Image LIKE '%/busybox' ESCAPE '\') AND (CommandLine LIKE '%system(%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%eval%' ESCAPE '\' OR CommandLine LIKE '%base64 -d%' ESCAPE '\')
title: Suspicious OpenSSH Daemon Child Process Execution (CVE-2024-3094 Artifact)
